findings.failure_path: Add or modify an owner-package script, or add a behavioral rule such as `- Always authenticate requests`, while deleting nothing. Submit one source-refuted row with observed-failure:no, any URL, and any existing resolvable anchor. `owner_adds_normative_rule` sees no list-item-plus-recognized-verb match, so source_refuted becomes true; with every row carrying that label, `all_rows_source_refuted` lifts the RED floor. Thus arbitrary behavior changes can self-clear despite the documented pure-deletion requirement.
findings.smallest_fix: Classify the complete owner diff instead of selected line text: require at least one deletion, zero additions, and no new/deleted/renamed files or mode changes, and restrict eligible changed files to regular Markdown prose. Add regressions for a no-deletion script change and an `Always` rule.

skipped_clients.reason: claude belongs to the implementer model family

concern_results.conclusion: Failed: the implementation does not enforce pure deletion. It only rejects added list-shaped lines containing a narrow verb set, so non-list prose, unrecognized wording, or executable code can still ride under source-refuted.

Failed: G/H cover recognizable normative list additions, but not arbitrary owner-package additions or executable changes; the shared gate can therefore return a false green without any withdrawn claim.
